heroHeadline: Government and drivers' confederation open Decree 5716 talks in La Paz with no deal; Santa Cruz transport threatens 48-hour strike from Oct 5
heroSubtitle: After a partial 24-hour transport stoppage on Sept. 28 (heaviest in Santa Cruz and Chuquisaca), Public Works Minister Mauricio Zamora and other ministers met the Confederación Sindical de Choferes de Bolivia on Sept. 29. The drivers demand abrogation of the diesel-subsidy decree; the meeting ended without agreement and talks continue. Santa Cruz transport leaders say they were not invited and will strike for 48 hours from Oct. 5 unless the subsidy is restored.
